description.zh: 创建时间段止，符合ISO8601标准的utc时间格式。
description.en: The end of the creation time range. The time must be in UTC and in the ISO 8601 format.

description.zh: 创建时间段起，符合ISO8601标准的utc时间格式。
description.en: The beginning of the creation time range. The time must be in UTC and in the ISO 8601 format.

description.zh: 结束时间段止，符合ISO8601标准的utc时间格式，例如2016-05-23T12:00:00Z。
description.en: The end of the end time range. The time must be in UTC and in the ISO 8601 format. For example, 2016-05-23T12:00:00Z.

description.zh: 结束时间段起，符合ISO8601标准的utc时间格式，例如2016-05-23T12:00:00Z。
description.en: The beginning of the end time range. The time must be in UTC and in the ISO 8601 format. For example, 2016-05-23T12:00:00Z.

description.zh: 实例ID。多个ID用英文逗号分隔，最大不超过100个。
description.en: The instance ID. You can specify up to 100 instance IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

description.zh: 每页条数，默认值为20，最大不超过300个。
description.en: The number of entries per page. The default value is 20. The maximum value is 300.

description.zh:
产品代码。可通过接口**QueryProductList**查询产品代码。

> 当设置了region时，不为空。
description.en:
The product code. You can call the **QueryProductList** operation to query the product code.

> Required when you specify the Region parameter.

description.zh:
续费状态，取值：
- AutoRenewal：自动续费。
- ManualRenewal：手动续费。
- NotRenewal：不续费。
description.en:
The renewal status. Valid values:

- AutoRenewal: auto-renewal

- ManualRenewal: manual renewal

- NotRenewal: no renewal

description.zh:
订阅类型。
- Subscription：预付费。
- PayAsYouGo：后付费。
description.en:
The subscription type.

- Subscription: subscription

- PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go
